name: wiseppc
description: Amazon Ads and seller analytics for WisePPC. Connects Cursor to the WisePPC MCP server for campaign performance, seller reports, and catalog health insights, then proposes ad changes for human approval in the WisePPC webapp.

WISEPPC_API_KEY.title: WisePPC API key
